statement: For every conductor m and prime ell, the continuous Q_ell unipotent completion of G_Q(mu_m) is free of rank r2(Q(mu_m))+1. Its canonical abelianization is the cyclotomic field tensor Q_ell modulo logarithms of global units, explicitly Q_ell plus the complex-conjugation minus subspace for m>=3. All finite-stage transition maps are induced by Galois inclusion and give field traces on abelianizations; a cofinal system admits compatible free generators with deletion transition maps.
manuscript_passages: Part E follow-up3; arithmetic relative completion over S3 times Zhat*, section51.16
notes: Every continuous unipotent representation kills inertia away ell by the exact Frobenius eigenvalue relation. The opened abelian-field Leopoldt theorem and finite Euler characteristic prove H2=0. A central-extension proof of the H2 injection and a lowest-degree free-Lie argument prove freeness. The continuous and abstract source categories remain explicitly specified. Original Brumer publisher metadata was verified, but the original full article was not obtained; the exact theorem and abelian-field reduction were opened in Sharifi's author notes.
